✨ 7 Body Care Ingredients That Actually Work Body concerns can feel confusing, but choosing the right ingredient makes it much easier 👀 Strawberry skin → Lactic acid Rough lips → Vaseline Body acne → Benzoyl peroxide Dark armpits → Niacinamide Ingrown hair → Salicylic acid Sweaty pits → Aluminum chloride Neck lines → Retinal Lactic acid can help smooth rough, bumpy-looking skin, Vaseline helps lock in moisture for dry lips, benzoyl peroxide is commonly used for body acne, and niacinamide can help support a more even-looking skin tone. Salicylic acid helps with clogged pores and ingrown hairs, aluminum chloride is commonly used to reduce excessive sweating, and retinal can help improve the appearance of fine lines over time. Some active ingredients can be irritating if overused, so start slowly and adjust based on your skin.
